explanation:
Current required by unit deflection is 60 A.

For, = 9 current is I = 9 60 A

I = 540 A = 540 106 A

Let G is resistance of galvanometer. Then,

[11000 + G] 90 106 = 1

99000 + 9G = 105

9G = 100000 99000

9G = 1000

Also, in half deflection method,

100 S = 11000 S = 110
